title: Part V · Section 01
subtitle: Notices
introEn: Read the passage and choose the best answer.

items.prompt: What should people who need to catch a train do?
items.passage: Questions 1-2 refer to the following notice. NOTICE This station will be closed for repairs because of water damage from the recent storms. It will be closed from Tuesday to Friday of this week. Passengers are advised to go to Brook Street station. We apologize for any inconvenience and thank you for your patience and understanding.

choices.B: The station is closed between Tuesday and Friday.
choices.D: The fare is cheaper. Questions 3-4 refer to the following notice. Below is the local weather forecast for the next 5 days. Monday: Rain in the morning, dry in the afternoon. Tuesday: Starts warm, but will get colder in the afternoon. Wednesday: Sunny and warm all day. Thursday: Light rain in morning, becoming dry later in the afternoon. Friday: Possible snow with strong winds all day. Heavy snow is predicted for the whole of the weekend.
